package.description: IPEVO CamControl is a user-friendly app for controlling your IPEVO document camera via USB. It requires minimal computer resources and is perfect for swift camera adjustments during video communication.

en-US.description: IPEVO CamControl is a user-friendly app for controlling your IPEVO document camera via USB. It requires minimal computer resources and is perfect for swift camera adjustments during video communication.
en-US.longDescription: CamControl provides basic controls for your IPEVO document camera, that allow on-the-fly adjustments of your camera's settings and don't require much of your computer's performance. Depending on what IPEVO camera you are using, you can adjust focus, brightness, white balance or zoom in, rotate image, and more, when connected via USB.
en-US.name: CAMCONTROL

zh-CN.description: IPEVO CamControl 是一款通过 USB 控制 IPEVO 实物展台的简易应用程序。它占用极少的电脑资源，特别适合在视频通讯过程中快速调整摄像头参数。
zh-CN.longDescription: CamControl 为您的 IPEVO 实物展台提供基础控制功能，可实时调整相机设置且几乎不占用电脑性能。根据您使用的 IPEVO 相机型号，通过 USB 连接后可调节对焦、亮度、白平衡或进行画面缩放、旋转等操作。
